intent: Signal store for dashboard. Public API: DashboardStore.state: Signal<ViewState>; DashboardStore.metric: Signal<BiometricMetric | null>; DashboardStore.ratios: Signal<TrainingRatio[]>; DashboardStore.steps: Signal<WorkoutStep[]>; DashboardStore.phases: Signal<PhaseProgress[]>; DashboardStore.gauges: Signal<GaugeValue[]>; DashboardStore.intensity: Signal<number>; DashboardStore.load(): void; DashboardStore.startLive(): void; DashboardStore.stopLive(): void; DashboardStore.resetRatios(): void. load() sets state 'loading', fetches snapshot/ratios/steps/phases (forkJoin), state 'empty' when no data, 'error' on failure, else 'success'. startLive() subscribes to streamLive(3000) updating metric; stopLive() unsubscribes. intensity = clamp(trainingLoad/10,0,100). gauges: two GaugeValue (completed steps % and remaining %). resetRatios() reloads ratios. Consumes TelemetryService.getSnapshot(): Observable<BiometricMetric>; TelemetryService.streamLive(intervalMs: number): Observable<BiometricMetric>; DashboardApi.getRatios(): Observable<TrainingRatio[]>; DashboardApi.getSteps(): Observable<WorkoutStep[]>; DashboardApi.getPhases(): Observable<PhaseProgress[]>.
